description: A PHP class 'Filter' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Task\Catalog' implementing various tasks related to catalog management, including generating and clearing country data files, and managing asynchronous tasks like listing countries and handling country info.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Main controller class handling catalog filtering tasks such as generating country JSON files, listing countries, retrieving country info, and cleaning up generated files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up a series of tasks related to articles and country language list generation, involving adding tasks for clearing and listing articles, and adding country list tasks for each store and language.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON list of countries for a specific store and language, saves it to a file, and handles directory creation and errors.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates detailed country information, including zones and geo-zones, and saves it as a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes existing JSON files related to countries across all stores and languages.
